title: AI is bringing back my inner child
author: commonsnook
selftext:
It's truly amazing how far Three.js and Astra is getting on ai game dev, it just reach to a point where I can fantasize about any world and bring it alive with a few dozen prompts.

Sure,[ the art quality might be questionable](https://x.com/voorloopnul/status/2101235414354862397) by someone standard, but if you are more into world building and mechanics the possibilities are endless!

It feels like all those dream games I imagined as a kid [might finally get a chance to exist.](https://x.com/voorloopnul/status/2101288992016601320) :)
